acceptanceCriteria: A provider example converts one exported trace into records the existing EEP contract accepts, with unresolved frames reported as unknowns.
docs/EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE-PROVIDERS.md documents the mapping and its privacy screen.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. An operator-exported Sentry or OpenTelemetry stack trace becomes an external-evidence record pinned to the release commit, and its frames feed `corvint context --subject`, so a bug-fix agent starts at the crashed code and its owning spec. Corvint fetches nothing (invariant 7); the operator supplies the file, and secret screening applies before any frame text enters a receipt. Frames that do not resolve at the pinned commit are unknowns, never guesses. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: extevidence: incident-to-context from an exported stack trace pinned to the deployed release SHA
